title: Iba1 immunoreactivity is enhanced following an antigen retrieval treatment with EDTA, pH 6.0
author: Ghatak, Combs

steps.title: Combination antigen retrieval (free floating)
steps.instruction: Perform the three‑step antigen retrieval on free‑floating sections in the order: trypsin‑EDTA digestion, two 5‑min rinses in ultrapure Type I water at room temperature, EDTA boiling, two 5‑min water rinses, formic acid treatment, and two final 5‑min water rinses.

substeps.instruction: Trypsin‑EDTA digestion (as in original protocol).
Rinse twice, 5 min each, with ultrapure Type I water at RT.
Boil sections in EDTA solution.
Rinse twice, 5 min each, with ultrapure Type I water at RT.
Treat sections with formic acid.
Rinse twice, 5 min each, with ultrapure Type I water at RT.

steps.title: EDTA boiling retrieval (slide mounted)
steps.instruction: Apply a single antigen‑retrieval step to slide‑mounted sections by boiling in 10 mM EDTA, pH 6.0, followed by two 5‑min rinses in ultrapure Type I water at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Boil sections in 10 mM EDTA, pH 6.0.
Rinse twice, 5 min each, with ultrapure Type I water at RT.

steps.title: Prepare tissue for staining
steps.instruction: After antigen retrieval, place free‑floating sections onto 70 µm mesh cell‑strainer inserts (catalog 352350, BD Falcon) in six‑well Cellstar plates (catalog 657‑160, Greiner Bio‑one) without lids; place slide‑mounted sections into a Prohisto slide‑staining container. Perform all rinses and incubations on a 55S Single Platform Shaker set to 10 rocking motions per minute; keep slide‑mounted sections on the benchtop without rocking.

substeps.instruction: Transfer free‑floating sections to mesh inserts in six‑well plates.
Place slide‑mounted sections in Prohisto container.
Set shaker to 10 rocks/min for all plate incubations.
Leave slide container on benchtop for its incubations.

steps.title: Peroxidase block
steps.instruction: Briefly wash sections in PBS for 5 min, incubate in 0.3 % H₂O₂ in PBS for 5 min at room temperature, then wash again in PBS for 5 min.

substeps.instruction: PBS wash 5 min.
Incubate 0.3 % H₂O₂ in PBS 5 min RT.
PBS wash 5 min.

steps.title: Block and primary antibody (Iba1)
steps.instruction: Block sections in PBS containing 0.5 % BSA, 5 % goat serum, and 0.1 % Triton X‑100 for 1 h, then incubate with anti‑Iba1 (rabbit polyclonal, 1:1000, catalog 019‑19741, Wako) overnight at 4 °C. Follow with four 10‑min washes in PBS.

substeps.instruction: Block 1 h in PBS + 0.5 % BSA + 5 % goat serum + 0.1 % Triton X‑100.
Incubate primary anti‑Iba1 (1:1000) overnight at 4 °C.
Wash 4 × 10 min with PBS.

steps.title: Secondary detection (Iba1)
steps.instruction: Incubate with biotinylated anti‑rabbit secondary antibody (1:2000, Vector) for 2 h at room temperature, wash four times with PBS, incubate with PBS‑Avidin‑Biotin solution (2 µL each of solutions A and B per mL PBS, Vectastain ABC kit) for 2 h at RT, wash four times with PBS, then develop with Vector VIP chromogen solution for 5 min according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

substeps.instruction: Biotinylated anti‑rabbit (1:2000) 2 h RT.
Wash 4 × PBS.
ABC solution (2 µL A + 2 µL B per mL PBS) 2 h RT.
Wash 4 × PBS.
Develop with Vector VIP chromogen 5 min.

steps.title: Block and primary antibody (Aβ)
steps.instruction: Block slide‑mounted or free‑floating sections with M.O.M.™ mouse Ig blocking reagent (M.O.M. kit, Vector) in PBS for 1 h, then incubate with anti‑β‑amyloid (4G8, 1:1000, catalog Sig 39220, Covance) overnight at 4 °C. Follow with four 10‑min PBS washes.

substeps.instruction: Block 1 h with M.O.M. mouse Ig blocking reagent in PBS.
Incubate primary anti‑β‑amyloid (1:1000) overnight at 4 °C.
Wash 4 × 10 min with PBS.

steps.title: Secondary detection (Aβ)
steps.instruction: Incubate with biotinylated anti‑mouse secondary antibody (1:9000, Vector) for 2 h at room temperature, wash four times with PBS, incubate with the same ABC solution as above for 2 h at RT, wash four times with PBS, then develop with Vector VIP chromogen for 5 min.

substeps.instruction: Biotinylated anti‑mouse (1:9000) 2 h RT.
Wash 4 × PBS.
ABC solution (2 µL A + 2 µL B per mL PBS) 2 h RT.
Wash 4 × PBS.
Develop with Vector VIP chromogen 5 min.

steps.title: Mount sections and dry
steps.instruction: Mount free‑floating sections onto gelatin‑subbed glass slides and allow to dry overnight; slide‑mounted sections are also left to dry overnight before further processing.

substeps.instruction: Place sections on gelatin‑subbed slides.
Dry overnight at room temperature.

steps.title: Dehydrate, clear, coverslip
steps.instruction: Serially dehydrate slides through distilled water, 50 % ethanol, 70 % ethanol, 95 % ethanol, and 100 % ethanol for 5 min each, then clear by two 5‑min rinses in Histoclear (National Diagnostics). Immediately coverslip with glass coverslips using Permount mounting media (Fisher Scientific) and dry overnight.

substeps.instruction: Dehydrate: water → 50 % EtOH → 70 % EtOH → 95 % EtOH → 100 % EtOH, 5 min each.
Clear: Histoclear 2 × 5 min.
Coverslip with glass coverslip and Permount.
Dry overnight.

steps.title: Capture microscope images
steps.instruction: Examine each slide on an upright Leica DM1000 microscope, acquire images of the temporal cortex with a DFC 320 digital camera using LAS V4.2 software, and assemble figures in Adobe Photoshop CS5.

substeps.instruction: Inspect slides on Leica DM1000.
Capture images with DFC 320 camera via LAS V4.2.
Process figures in Adobe Photoshop CS5.
